methods: Read applicable AGENTS.md, compatibility-maintenance.md, architecture.md, request-preparation.md and current baseline.

groups.reason: Retained writers already use shared exclusive empty-before-ACL private creation and same-directory protected publication; absent siblings are not added.
Kimi durable OAuth, pooled credential metadata, legacy migration and generic harness-document/DSH owners are absent from Lite. Shared fsync option is only needed by the absent Kimi owner.

Lite already captures child error/close immediately, refreshes changed native client_version metadata, sends Responses-native models directly to the API forwarder, and publishes skill entries with COPYFILE_EXCL.

Fixed routed, compaction, external forwarder and WebSocket HTTP-adapter POSTs already set redirect:error; native no-replay behavior and same/cross-origin regressions are present. Upstream failover/vision/provider-pool extensions are outside Lite.

A bounded final supervisor teardown is potentially useful, but upstream process.exit timeout is incompatible with Lite retaining native process-generation cleanup custody after child close. No retained lost-close reproduction was observed. Do not treat a timeout as successful cleanup or release the service lock while witnesses are pending.
groups.followUp: Investigate only with a retained shutdown hang; bound liveness without weakening positive process-absence proof or cleanup custody.

groups.reason: Upstream rejects completed blank calls using tool inventory and drops exact history call/output pairs carrying a Codex EOF parse error. Lite deliberately preserves ordinary raw argument strings and emits content-free diagnostics. Importing this gate changes streamed execution and history semantics; retain existing malformed-JSON-gate deferral until an exact retained-provider reproduction justifies it. Upstream no-input detection must also be reconciled with current request-local inputSchema/parameters authority.
groups.followUp: If reproduced, isolate output rejection from retry and history rewriting, and validate current/discovered schemas without inventing arguments.

groups.reason: Native encrypted-relay successful terminal, strict UTF-8/SSE, unambiguous JSON, single payload, identities and closed/final payload consistency are already enforced in Lite. Upstream's additional affinity-header filtering, delta/done prefix checks, expanded failure classification and compaction-instruction rewrite are not copied: Lite deliberately accepts only authoritative completed snapshots and does not reconstruct plaintext from deltas. Grok argument-stream changes are excluded.
groups.followUp: Revisit header projection or snapshot diagnostics only if the installed Codex representation or a retained encrypted-handoff observation exposes a mismatch; preserve Responses Lite context and exact plaintext.

groups.reason: Most of the upstream fix owns multi-account pools and profile login switching absent from Lite. Its catalog race check also requires byte-identical bearer tokens. Lite deliberately scopes catalog identity to native account plus residency/FedRAMP and allows token renewal for the same account; do not replace that with upstream pool semantics absent a retained identity-switch reproduction.
groups.followUp: If same-workspace distinct-user use is requested or reproduced, design identity from current native session authority while retaining ordinary bearer-renewal semantics.

groups.reason: Generic per-model service planning adds no necessary capability for the fixed retained OpenRouter set with the GLM gateway; selected Switchyard startup and native frontend survival already have Lite-specific supervision.

Tool-result aging, retained archives, signed search scopes, optional notices and readback proof owners are absent. Adding those systems would change preserved history and exceed the personal workflow scope.

Grok OAuth/API editing codecs, patch feedback, model-visible guidance, benchmark timing, native usage tiers and OpenCode Go Gemini/free models are not retained providers. The namespace diff in 5eb18617 exclusively adds codec providerName/history-v1 identities for that excluded Grok patch bridge.

Upstream-only generic fixture owners, absent process-tree capture, service-launch fixture wiring already covered locally, README/localization/release docs, CI rerun, Homebrew action and Control Center Vite updates do not alter Lite's retained runtime.
Combined-diff filenames and dense combined patches reviewed; conflict resolutions preserve already dispositioned changes and require no wholesale merge.
